sources.title: multimodal/examples/albef/README.md at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: ALBEF (Li et al., 2021) is a multimodal understanding model that uses a contrastive loss to align unimodal embeddings prior to fusing them via a multimodal transformer encoder. It additionally uses momentum distillation to generate and learn from pseudo-targets using EMA versions of model weights.
